text-pretty algolia-lvl2">Overview<a href="#overview" id="Overview" class="text-link ml-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 group-hover:opacity-100"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" role="presentation" class="inline-block h-4 w-4"><path d="M9.75027 5.52371L10.7168 4.55722C13.1264 2.14759 17.0332 2.14759 19.4428 19.4428L14.2478 18.4782M9.5 14.5L14.5 9.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"></path></svg></a></h2><p>Voice agent speech is produced by a TTS model, configured with a voice profile that specifies tone, accent, and other qualitative characteristics of the speech. The TTS model runs on output from an <a class="group/link text-fg0 hover:text-fgAccentPrimary1 hover:decoration-fgAccentPrimary1 inline underline decoration-[1.2px] underline-offset-4 transition-colors group-data-[component=callout]:text-current hover:decoration-[1.5px]" href="/agents/models/llm/">LLM</a> model to speak the agent response to the user.</p><p>You can choose a voice model served through LiveKit Inference, included with LiveKit Cloud. With LiveKit Inference, your agent runs on LiveKit&#x27;s infrastructure to minimize latency. No separate provider API key is required, and usage and rate limits are managed through LiveKit Cloud. Use the plugin instead if you prefer to manage billing and rate limits yourself, or need access to a provider not currently available through LiveKit Inference.</p><h2 id="inference" class="font-display text-fg0 group mt-10 mb-2 text-2xl text-pretty algolia-lvl2">LiveKit Inference <a href="#inference" id="inference" class="text-link ml-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 group-hover:opacity-100"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" role="presentation" class="inline-block h-4 w-4"><path d="M9.75027 5.52371L10.7168 4.55722C13.1264 2.14759 17.0332 2.14759 19.4428 4.55722C21.8524 6.96684 21.8524 10.8736 19.4428 13.2832L18.4742 14.2519M5.52886 9.74513L4.55722 10.7168C2.14759 13.1264 2.1476 17.0332 4.55722 19.4428C6.96684 21.8524 10.8736 21.8524 13.2832 19.4428L14.2478 18.4782M9.5 14.5L14.5 9.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"></path></svg></a></h2><p>LiveKit Inference provides a curated set of TTS models with managed billing and rate limits. Each model comes with a limited selection of <a class="group/link text-fg0 hover:text-fgAccentPrimary1 hover:decoration-fgAccentPrimary1 inline underline decoration-[1.2px] underline-offset-4 transition-colors group-data-[component=callout]:text-current hover:decoration-[1.5px]" href="#voices">Suggested voices</a>, plus a wider selection through each provider&#x27;s documentation.</p><h3 id="models" class="font-display text-fg0 group mt-10 mb-2 text-xl text-pretty algolia-lvl3">Models <a href="#models" id="models" class="text-link ml-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 group-hover:opacity-100"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" role="presentation" class="inline-block h-4 w-4"><path d="M9.75027 5.52371L10.7168 4.55722C13.1264 2.14759 17.0332 2.14759 19.4428 4.55722C21.8524 6.96684 21.8524 10.8736 19.4428 13.2832L18.4742 14.2519M5.52886 9.74513L4.55722 10.7168C2.14759 13.1264 2.1476 17.0332 4.55722 19.4428C6.96684 21.8524 10.8736 21.8524 13.2832 19.4428L14.2478 18.4782M9.5 14.5L14.5 9.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"></path></svg></a></h3><p>The following models are available in <a class="group/link text-fg0 hover:text-fgAccentPrimary1 hover:decoration-fgAccentPrimary1 inline underline decoration-[1.2px] underline-offset-4 transition-colors group-data-[component=callout]:text-current hover:decoration-[1.5px]" href="/agents/models/#inference">LiveKit Inference</a>.
